title: mvn test: unknown coupon code fails PricingTest with a NullPointerException
body:
`Pricing.applyCoupon` should leave the amount alone when the coupon code
is not in the map. Instead the build fails.

```bash
mvn test
```

```
[INFO] Running com.example.shop.PricingTest
[ERROR] Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 0.017 s <<< FAILURE! -- in com.example.shop.PricingTest
[ERROR] com.example.shop.PricingTest.unknownCouponIsIgnored -- Time elapsed: 0.003 s <<< ERROR!
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "java.lang.Integer.intValue()" because the return value of "java.util.Map.get(Object)" is null
	at com.example.shop.Pricing.applyCoupon(Pricing.java:13)
	at com.example.shop.PricingTest.unknownCouponIsIgnored(PricingTest.java:22)
	at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:565)
	at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.forEach(ArrayList.java:1612)
	at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.forEach(ArrayList.java:1612)

[INFO] 
[INFO] Results:
[INFO] 
[ERROR] Failures: 
[ERROR]   ShippingTest.flatRateUnderThreshold:19 expected: <499> but was: <599>
[ERROR]   ShippingTest.flatRateUnderThreshold:19 expected: <499> but was: <599>
[ERROR]   ShippingTest.freeOverFiftyDollars:13 expected: <0> but was: <599>
[ERROR] Errors: 
[ERROR]   PricingTest.unknownCouponIsIgnored:22 » NullPointer Cannot invoke "java.lang.Integer.intValue()" because the return value of "java.util.Map.get(Object)" is null
[INFO] 
[ERROR] Tests run: 5, Failures: 3, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0
```

This is on Maven 3.9.16 with Surefire 3.5.2 and JDK 26.
